acip: GNYIS PA YAN LAG BDUN PO DE BSAGS SBYANG SPEL GSUM DU 'DU BAR BSTAN PA NI, PHYAG DANG MCHOD PA YI RANG DANG BSKUL BA DANG GSOL 'DEBS LNGA NI, TSOGS GSOGS PA'I YAN LAG ,BSHAGS PA NI SGRIB PA SBYONG BA'I YAN LAG, BSNGO BA NI DGE BA MI ZAD CING GONG 'PHEL DU BYED PA'I YAN LAG GO , (,ZHES YAN LAG BDUN PA 'BUL ZHING, LONG BYUNG TSE, BSHAGS PA'I MTSAMS SU SDOM PA GSUM SO SO'I BSHAGS PA DANG, BLA MA RDOR 'DZIN MA DANG, BYANG CHUB LTUNG BSHAGS SOGS BYA'O,,)
wylie: gnyis pa yan lag bdun po de bsags sbyang spel gsum du 'du bar bstan pa ni, phyag dang mchod pa yi rang dang bskul ba dang gsol 'debs lnga ni, tshogs gsogs pa'i yan lag ,bshags pa ni sgrib pa sbyong ba'i yan lag, bsngo ba ni dge ba mi zad cing gong 'phel du byed pa'i yan lag go , (,zhes yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing, long byung tshe, bshags pa'i mtshams su sdom pa gsum so so'i bshags pa dang, bla ma rdor 'dzin ma dang, byang chub ltung bshags sogs bya'o,,)
english: This brings us back to our original second point, which is the presentation of a summary of everything into the three points of collecting good deeds; clearing ourselves of obstacles; and increasing the power.  Now the five steps of bowing down to our Lama, making Them offerings, rejoicing in the goodness of all, entreating our Lama to teach, and supplicating Them to stay can all be considered steps where we are collecting good deeds--good karma.  The step of confession is one where we clear ourselves of obstacles.  And then the step of dedication is one where we assure that our good deeds will never wear out, but rather grow ever higher.  Practice thus the Seven Steps.  At the point where you offer your confession, you can--if time permits--confess transgressions of any of the individual vows found in the three sets of commitments; recite the Prayer of the Lama, the Keeper of the Diamond; and go through the Confession of the Downfalls of a Bodhisattva, or other similar practices.
